queries.description: Total revenue per month from delivered orders.
example_questions: How much did we make each month?
queries.sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_date) AS month, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month;

queries.description: Top 5 products ranked by revenue from delivered orders.
example_questions: What are our best selling products?
queries.sql: SELECT p.name AS product, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 5;

queries.description: Revenue from delivered orders grouped by customer country.
example_questions: Where are our customers located and how much do they spend?
queries.sql: SELECT c.country, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' GROUP BY c.country ORDER BY revenue DESC;

queries.description: Top 10 customers by total spend on delivered orders.
queries.sql: SELECT c.name AS customer, c.country, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2) AS total_spend FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' GROUP BY c.id, c.name, c.country ORDER BY total_spend DESC LIMIT 10;

queries.description: Average value of a delivered order.
example_questions: What is the average order value?
How much does a typical order cost?
queries.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.id), 2) AS average_order_value FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = 'delivered';

queries.description: Number of orders in each status (delivered, shipped, cancelled).
queries.sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders GROUP BY status ORDER BY order_count DESC;

queries.description: Revenue and units sold per product category from delivered orders.
example_questions: How many units did each category sell?
queries.sql: SELECT p.category, SUM(oi.quantity) AS units_sold, ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price), 2) AS revenue FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY revenue DESC;

queries.description: Number of customers who signed up in each year.
example_questions: How many new customers did we get each year?
queries.sql: SELECT strftime('%Y', signup_date) AS signup_year, COUNT(*) AS new_customers FROM customers GROUP BY signup_year ORDER BY signup_year;

queries.description: All products with their category and price, cheapest first within each category.
example_questions: What is the price of each item?
queries.sql: SELECT category, name AS product, price FROM products ORDER BY category, price;
